summary: Iteration 21 — owner_name field + Unduh Gambar PNG verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS (test_iteration21_owner_name.py): (1) POST /api/vouchers with owner_name persists it and GET /api/vouchers/{id} returns it (no $oid leak, _id is str); (2) POST /api/vouchers omitting owner_name is backward compatible (defaults to ''); (3) mark-printed → redeem snapshots owner_name into redemption_logs, GET /api/reports/daily returns redemptions[].owner_name with no ObjectId leak and no _id fields; (4) legacy redemption_logs docs lacking owner_name (inserted directly via pymongo) render as '-' in the report; (5) date filter with 1990 window returns empty report/redemptions arrays. Playwright frontend smoke on desktop 1280×900 + mobile 390×844: logged in as OwnerReportTest1788836239/654321, created a TUI-prefixed voucher with owner_name='Rahasia Owner' via authenticated fetch, verified: card at data-testid=voucher-card-<code> does NOT contain 'Rahasia Owner'; btn-download-<code> exists and fires a browser download whose suggested filename is exactly voucher-<code>.png; detail modal opened via btn-view-<code> does NOT contain owner_name; btn-detail-download-<code> also produces voucher-<code>.png; mark-printed + redeem via fetch returned 200; /admin/reports body text contains the owner name and data-testid=redemption-details-table is present; mobile /admin/vouchers loads without error. Created voucher cleaned up via DELETE 200. No pageerror observed.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py VoucherCreate: owner_name default '' + max_length=100 preserves backward compatibility while accepting new field. Good.
POST /api/vouchers stores voucher['owner_name'] = data.owner_name.strip(); voucher dict is inserted then returned with _id stringified — no ObjectId leak. Good.

POST /api/vouchers/redeem snapshots owner_name into redemption_logs via result.get('owner_name',''), so redemption history is preserved even if the voucher (or its owner_name field) is later mutated/deleted. Good design.
GET /api/reports/daily projects {_id:0} for redemptions and coalesces missing owner_name to '-' via redemption.get('owner_name') or '-'. Legacy rows without the field render safely as '-' — verified.

frontend/src/pages/VoucherManagement.js renderVoucherCanvas(voucher, settings) is called from handleDownloadImage without ever touching voucher.owner_name; escpos.js renderVoucherCanvas has no reference to owner_name; PrintVoucher.js has no reference. Owner name cannot appear in either the PNG download path or the printable ESC/POS output. Verified by source inspection + UI leak check.

CreateVoucher.js marks Nama Pemilik Voucher input as required — this is intentional per PRD (owner name always required), but if backward-compat clients hit the API directly it still works (backend accepts empty).
Reports.js Detail Penukaran table + CSV export both include owner_name (falling back to '-'). data-testid=redemption-detail-owner-<i> present for scripted verification. Good.
Style/repeat comment: server.py still >1100 lines — refactor into routers/{auth,users,vouchers,reports,settings}.py + services/{email,qr}.py for maintainability (repeat from iter20, not blocking).
Nit: VoucherCreate model does not trim whitespace at Pydantic validation level; the endpoint calls .strip() manually. A field_validator would move the invariant closer to the schema.
